name: xTool F2 Ultra
notes: Galvo laser with a 1064 nm MOPA fiber laser and a 455 nm blue diode.
source: Image modes: xTool Studio's image mode list, values read from projects saved by xTool Studio for the M2 (2026-11-27); assumed the same for this machine. xTool Studio 1.9.11 device extension GS004-CLASS-4 (exts/GS004-CLASS-4), read 2026-11-26. Work area from processingArea (LASER_PLANE 220 x 220); modules from defaultPower [60, 40] (redPower, laserPower), the wavelength map BLUE 455 / RED 1064 and the MOPA IR label. Which operations each module can do is an assumption.
